fund_type: Open-ended equity scheme predominantly investing in mid cap stocks

lock_in_period.description: Nil. This is an open-ended equity fund with no statutory lock-in period.

expense_ratio.description: The Total Expense Ratio (TER) for HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Plan - Growth is 0.74% (inclusive of GST).

exit_load.description: An exit load of 1.00% is applicable for units redeemed or switched out within 1 year (365 days) from the date of allotment. No exit load is payable for units redeemed after 1 year.

investment_limits.description: The minimum SIP investment amount is ₹100 per installment. The minimum lump sum investment amount for initial as well as additional purchases is ₹100.

taxation.short_term_capital_gains: STCG is taxed at 20% if redeemed within 12 months.
taxation.long_term_capital_gains: LTCG above ₹1.25 Lakh in a financial year is taxed at 12.5% without indexation if held for more than 12 months.

operations.account_statement_procedure: Account statements and capital gains reports can be downloaded online from the Groww App under Profile > Reports or directly via the HDFC MF online investor portal using your PAN and Folio number.
operations.folio_lookup: Check registered folio numbers in your Groww mutual funds dashboard or consolidated account statement (CAS).
